project.name: Datas.ar
project.summary: Open-source app that reads your device and runs the best open AI it can carry. Built on the projects below — Datas is the glue.

sources.name: llama.cpp
sources.role: The engine that runs the AI models (llama-server, pooling over RPC, benchmarks).

sources.name: Hugging Face Hub
sources.role: Where the open models are downloaded from, with verified file sizes and checksums.

sources.name: Qwen (Qwen3, 3.5, 3.6, 3.8, Qwen3-Coder-Next)
sources.role: Open-weight models in the catalog.

sources.name: Gemma 4
sources.role: Open-weight models in the catalog (E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B).

sources.name: gpt-oss 20B / 120B
sources.role: Open-weight models in the catalog.

sources.name: Phi-4 mini
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: SmolLM3
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: MiMo V2.6 Distill
sources.role: Open-weight model in the catalog.

sources.name: Unsloth GGUF conversions
sources.role: Ready-to-run model files where no official conversion exists.

sources.name: psutil
sources.role: Reads memory, CPU, disk and battery.

sources.name: py-cpuinfo
sources.role: Reads the processor name and features.

sources.name: nvidia-ml-py
sources.role: Reads NVIDIA graphics memory.

sources.name: FastAPI + Starlette + uvicorn
sources.role: The local server behind the window.

sources.name: pywebview
sources.role: Shows the app in its own window instead of a browser.

sources.name: pydantic
sources.role: Checks the catalog file is well-formed.

sources.name: httpx
sources.role: Downloads and talks to AI services.

sources.name: python-zeroconf
sources.role: Finds your other devices on the home network.

sources.name: Pillow
sources.role: Pictures: the picture of the screen, sizes and formats of photos.

sources.name: pySerial
sources.role: Talks to boards and instruments on a serial cable (Arduino, ESP32, 3D printers).

sources.name: Eclipse Paho MQTT
sources.role: Sends and reads the short messages of smart-home devices through your own broker (MQTT).
sources.by: Eclipse Foundation, Roger Light and contributors

sources.name: PyAutoGUI
sources.role: Moves the mouse and types when you let the agent do so (experimental). Comes with PyScreeze, PyTweening, PyGetWindow, PyMsgBox, MouseInfo and, on Linux, python-xlib.
sources.by: Al Sweigart; python-xlib by Peter Liljenberg and contributors
sources.license: BSD (PyAutoGUI, PyGetWindow); MIT (PyScreeze, PyTweening); GPL-3.0-or-later (MouseInfo, PyMsgBox); GPL-2.0-or-later (python-xlib)

sources.name: Home Assistant, MQTT and Modbus
sources.role: Open ways of talking to home and industrial devices. Datas speaks them to your own hub and devices; nothing of theirs is included.
sources.by: Home Assistant project; OASIS (MQTT); Modbus Organization

sources.name: typer + rich
sources.role: The command-line version for advanced users.

sources.name: platformdirs
sources.role: Finds the right folders on each operating system.

sources.name: PyInstaller + Inno Setup
sources.role: Package the Windows installer.

sources.name: llmfit, canirunllm, llm-checker
sources.role: Earlier tools whose idea — match models to hardware with plain arithmetic — Datas follows.

sources.name: exo
sources.role: Showed home devices can share one big model; inspiration for pooling.

sources.name: PocketPal AI, Google AI Edge Gallery
sources.role: References for the Android app.

sources.name: whisper.cpp
sources.role: Hearing: turns your voice into text, on the processor (speech-to-text).
sources.by: ggml-org / Georgi Gerganov and contributors; Whisper weights by OpenAI

sources.name: pywhispercpp
sources.role: Python bindings that let Datas run whisper.cpp inside the app (prebuilt for Windows, macOS, Linux).

sources.name: Kokoro-82M
sources.role: Speaking: the voice that reads answers aloud in English and Spanish (text-to-speech).

sources.name: kokoro-onnx
sources.role: ONNX export of Kokoro, its voice pack and the small library that runs it.

sources.name: ONNX Runtime
sources.role: Runs the Kokoro voice model on the processor.

sources.name: espeak-ng
sources.role: Turns written words into phonemes (sounds) for the voice; shipped via espeakng-loader.

sources.name: python-sounddevice / PortAudio
sources.role: Microphone capture for the Talk button.

sources.name: stable-diffusion.cpp
sources.role: Making images (and, later, video): the engine behind the Images screen (sd-server).

sources.name: Z-Image-Turbo
sources.role: The picture model Datas downloads for making images (6 B parameters, 8 steps).
sources.license: Apache-2.0 (as stated on the model card)

sources.name: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (text encoder)
sources.role: Reads your description for the picture model.

sources.name: FLUX.1 autoencoder (ae.safetensors)
sources.role: Turns the picture model's output into pixels (VAE).

sources.name: uv
sources.role: Sets up Python and isolated environments for the third-party tools under "More tools".

sources.name: ComfyUI
sources.role: Optional tool (More tools): the workshop for making and editing images and video.

sources.name: FaceFusion
sources.role: Optional tool (More tools): face swap, lip-sync, face and frame restoration.

sources.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
sources.role: The video model Datas downloads for making clips.
sources.by: Wan-AI (Alibaba); GGUF by QuantStack; umt5-xxl encoder GGUF by city96; VAE repackaged by Comfy-Org
sources.license: Apache-2.0 (as stated on the model card)

sources.name: Qwen2.5-Math, Saul-7B, MedGemma
sources.role: Specialist chat models offered on Home (math, legal texts, medical).
sources.by: Alibaba Qwen; Equall; Google — GGUF by bartowski, mradermacher, Unsloth
sources.license: Apache-2.0; MIT; Health AI Developer Foundations terms

sources.name: FFmpeg (builds gathered by static-ffmpeg)
sources.role: Reads cameras, recordings and video. Fetched once when it is not already on the computer, from one fixed commit and checked against its SHA-256.
sources.by: FFmpeg project; builds by BtbN, gyan.dev, evermeet.cx and osxexperts.net, gathered by zackees
sources.license: LGPL/GPL (FFmpeg, as published by each builder); MIT (static-ffmpeg)

sources.name: Hermes 4 (14B, 4.3 36B, 70B)
sources.role: General chat AIs offered in the list of AIs.
sources.by: Nous Research — built on Qwen3 14B, Seed-OSS 36B and Llama 3.1 70B; GGUF by bartowski, Nous Research, lmstudio-community
sources.license: Apache-2.0 (14B, 4.3 36B); Llama 3 licence (70B) — as stated on the model cards

sources.name: Dolphin 3.0 (Llama 3.1 8B)
sources.role: General chat AI offered in the list of AIs.
sources.by: Cognitive Computations (Dolphin) — built on Meta Llama 3.1 8B
sources.license: Llama 3.1 licence — as stated on the model card

sources.name: pypdf
sources.role: Reads the PDF files you attach or keep at hand.

sources.name: python-docx
sources.role: Reads and writes Word documents (.docx).

sources.name: openpyxl
sources.role: Reads and writes Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx).

sources.name: python-pptx
sources.role: Reads and writes PowerPoint presentations (.pptx).

sources.name: fpdf2
sources.role: Writes PDF files from the AI's answers.

sources.name: markdown-it-py
sources.role: Reads the structure of an answer (headings, lists, tables) so it can be saved as a document.

sources.name: cryptography
sources.role: Creates each device's key and certificate for the encrypted link between your own devices.

sources.name: PyQt6 + Qt WebEngine
sources.role: The window on Linux.
sources.license: GPL-3.0-only (PyQt6); LGPL v3 (Qt libraries) — from the packages' own metadata

sources.name: Asap
sources.role: The typeface of the whole window.

sources.name: MuseoModerno
sources.role: The typeface of the name "Datas".

sources.name: DejaVu fonts
sources.role: The typeface inside the PDF files Datas writes (it covers many alphabets).
sources.by: DejaVu fonts team, based on Bitstream Vera
sources.license: Bitstream Vera licence; DejaVu changes in the public domain

sources.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
sources.role: The open standard Datas' agent speaks to use the functions other programs offer.

sources.name: ArtCraft
sources.role: Open creative apps the agent can work with; Datas can fetch its launcher.
sources.license: MIT or Apache-2.0 — as stated on its site

sources.name: DuckDuckGo
sources.role: Web search results, only when you switch internet on for a chat or the agent.

sources.name: gguf-py
sources.role: Reads the header of a model file to measure exactly what it needs.

sources.name: QtPy
sources.role: Lets the Linux window use Qt.

sources.name: AndroidX (AppCompat, Core KTX) and Material Components
sources.role: Building blocks of the Android app's screens.
sources.by: Google / the Android Open Source Project

sources.name: Kotlin and the Android Gradle Plugin
sources.role: Language and build tools of the Android app.

sources.name: SwiftUI, Network.framework, CryptoKit, WebKit
sources.role: Apple's own frameworks the iPhone app is built on: screens, the encrypted link, the window that shows a computer's Datas.

sources.name: XcodeGen
sources.role: Generates the Xcode project of the iPhone app from a short text file.

sources.name: Hatchling
sources.role: Builds the Python package.

sources.name: GitHub Actions (checkout, setup-python, setup-java, upload-artifact, attest-build-provenance) and action-gh-release
sources.role: Build, test and publish every version on clean machines; record where each file was built.

sources.name: pytest, pytest-asyncio, Ruff, mypy
sources.role: Tests and code checks used while building Datas (not shipped).

sources.name: FEMA and Ready.gov
sources.role: Offline survival library: Are You Ready? / ¿Está listo?, the CERT manual, the guide for older adults.
sources.license: US Government work (public domain in the USA)

sources.name: CDC and US CPSC
sources.role: Offline survival library: making water safe, generators and carbon monoxide.
sources.by: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; Consumer Product Safety Commission
sources.license: US Government work (public domain in the USA)

sources.name: WHO / WEDC technical notes
sources.role: Offline survival library: water, sanitation and hygiene in emergencies for a whole community.
sources.by: World Health Organization; Water, Engineering and Development Centre, Loughborough University
sources.license: © WHO — downloaded from the publisher for your own use

sources.name: Hesperian Health Guides
sources.role: Offline survival library: chapters of Where There Is No Doctor / Donde no hay doctor and A Community Guide to Environmental Health.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.role: Offline survival library: public-domain books (Mutual Aid, camp-craft, Walden, Robinson Crusoe, Verne, Don Quijote, Martín Fierro).
sources.license: Public domain in the USA (Project Gutenberg License)

sources.name: Kiwix and Meshtastic
sources.role: Recommended in the survival guides (not included): offline Wikipedia/WikiMed, and text messages over LoRa radios with no phone network.
